nodes.summary: For $r \in \mathbb{N}$, maps $a, b : \{0, \dots, r - 1\} \to \mathbb{N}$ and a finite sequence $A = (x_1, \dots, x_n)$ of natural numbers, $T(A)$ is the sequence of length $rn$ obtained by listing the blocks $(a_i x_1 + b_i, \dots, a_i x_n + b_i)$ one after another for $i = 0, 1, \dots, r - 1$.
nodes.title: Affine expansion of a sequence

nodes.summary: For every $r \in \mathbb{N}$ and all maps $a, b : \{0, \dots, r - 1\} \to \mathbb{N}$ with $a_i \ge 1$ for every $i$ and $\sum_{i < r} 1 / a_i > 1$, let $T$ send a finite sequence $(x_1, \dots, x_n)$ of natural numbers to the sequence of all $a_i x_j + b_i$, listed in blocks for $i = 0, 1, \dots, r - 1$. Then, starting from $A_1 = (1)$ with $A_{k+1} = T(A_k)$, some $A_k$ has a repeated entry.
